title:
一、英譯中：請將下列文章翻譯成中文。（20 分）
A reciprocal tariff is a tax or trade restriction that one country places on another in response to similar actions taken by that country. The idea behind reciprocal tariffs is to create balance in trade between nations. If one country raises tariffs on goods from another, the affected country might respond by imposing its own tariffs on imports from the first country. This response is meant to protect local businesses, preserve jobs, and fix trade imbalances.
Reciprocal tariffs can lead to a back-and-forth increase in trade barriers, potentially resulting in a trade war that negatively impacts both economies. Such situations can disrupt supply chains, raise prices for consumers, and slow down economic growth. It is important for countries to communicate openly and work together to settle trade issues instead of turning to reciprocal tariffs.
answer:
對等關稅是指一國針對另一國所採取的類似措施，而對該國課徵的稅或施加的貿易限制。對等關稅背後的理念，是在各國之間建立貿易平衡。若一國提高對另一國商品的關稅，受影響的國家可能會以對來自第一國的進口商品課徵自己的關稅作為回應。這種回應旨在保護本國企業、保住就業機會，並修正貿易失衡。
對等關稅可能導致貿易壁壘你來我往地不斷升高，最終引發貿易戰，對雙方經濟都造成負面影響。這類情況會打亂供應鏈、推高消費者物價，並拖慢經濟成長。各國應公開溝通、攜手解決貿易問題，而不是訴諸對等關稅，這一點至關重要。
hint:
第一段句構
  • A reciprocal tariff is a tax or trade restriction：主幹是「對等關稅是一種稅或貿易限制」。
  • that one country places on another：關係子句修飾 tax or trade restriction（一國對另一國施加的）。
  • in response to similar actions taken by that country：介系詞片語表原因（回應對方所採取的類似措施）；taken by that country 是過去分詞片語修飾 actions。
  • If one country raises tariffs on goods from another, the affected country might respond by imposing...：條件句；respond by + V-ing＝以……作為回應。
  • is meant to＝旨在、目的在於；後面接三個原形動詞 protect / preserve / fix。
第二段句構
  • can lead to a back-and-forth increase in trade barriers：back-and-forth 當形容詞，譯「你來我往的、反覆的」。
  • potentially resulting in a trade war that negatively impacts both economies：resulting in 是分詞構句表結果；that 子句修飾 trade war。
  • It is important for countries to communicate openly and work together：It 是形式主語，真正主語是 to communicate... and work...。
  • instead of turning to reciprocal tariffs：instead of + V-ing＝而不是……。
關鍵詞
  • reciprocal tariff 對等關稅；trade restriction 貿易限制
  • impose tariffs on 對……課徵關稅；trade imbalance 貿易失衡
  • trade barrier 貿易壁壘；trade war 貿易戰；supply chain 供應鏈
  • preserve jobs 保住就業；slow down economic growth 拖慢經濟成長
翻譯技巧
  • 英文的被動與分詞片語，中文常改成主動句：the affected country might respond → 「受影響的國家可能會……作為回應」。
  • 長句宜依語意斷句：第一段拆成三句，第二段拆成三句，讀起來才順。
  • 「It is important for countries to...」可譯成「各國應……，這一點至關重要」，比直譯「對各國而言重要的是……」自然。

title:
二、英文寫作：請根據下列指示寫一篇英文作文。（30 分）
“Public trust is the foundation of effective governance.”
Discuss the factors that influence public trust in government institutions. Propose measures that civil servants can take to strengthen transparency, accountability, and citizen confidence.
answer:
Public trust is the foundation of effective governance: without it, even well-designed policies are met with suspicion, compliance falls, and reforms stall. Several factors shape whether citizens trust government institutions.

The first is transparency. When decisions about budgets, procurement, or permits are made behind closed doors, people tend to assume the worst. The second is accountability. If officials who abuse their power are rarely disciplined, the public concludes that rules apply only to ordinary citizens. The third is responsiveness: slow replies and impersonal service convince people that the state does not care. Finally, consistency matters; policies that change direction abruptly, or are applied differently to different people, erode confidence faster than any single mistake.

Civil servants can take practical steps to rebuild trust. First, they can make procedures visible by publishing clear criteria, timelines, and fees, and by explaining decisions in plain language. Second, they can strengthen accountability by keeping complete records, referring questionable requests upward, and treating every complaint as a chance to correct a weakness rather than a threat. Third, they can engage citizens directly: consultation meetings, accessible hotlines, and follow-up reports show that feedback leads to action. Fourth, ethics training and the rotation of sensitive posts reduce the risk of capture and demonstrate that integrity is enforced, not merely proclaimed.

Trust is built slowly and lost quickly. For a customs officer, the same principle applies at the counter every day: a clear explanation, a fair decision, and a promise kept are small acts that, repeated a million times, become the credibility of the state.
hint:
審題
  • 題目有兩個任務：①討論影響民眾信任政府的因素；②提出公務人員可採行的措施（透明、課責、民眾信心）。
  • 兩部分都要寫到，不能只寫因素或只寫措施，否則分數會打折。
  • 建議立場：信任來自「透明、課責、回應性、一致性」，而公務人員是第一線的實踐者。
四段架構
  • 第一段（引言）：點出「信任是有效治理的基礎」，說明沒有信任的後果（政策被懷疑、順服度下降、改革停滯），並預告下文將談因素與措施。
  • 第二段（因素）：四個因素各 1–2 句——透明（黑箱決策讓人往壞處想）、課責（濫權不受懲處）、回應性（回覆慢、態度冷漠）、一致性（政策反覆、差別待遇）。
  • 第三段（措施）：對應四項具體作法——公開標準與流程、完整紀錄與逐級陳報、公民參與（座談、熱線、回饋報告）、倫理訓練與職務輪調。
  • 第四段（結論）：收束「信任建立慢、失去快」，並以海關第一線情境收尾（清楚的解釋、公平的決定、守住的承諾）。
關鍵詞彙
  • public trust 公眾信任；effective governance 有效治理；compliance 順服、遵守
  • transparency 透明；accountability 課責；responsiveness 回應性；consistency 一致性
  • behind closed doors 黑箱作業；abuse of power 濫權；disciplined 受懲處
  • procurement 採購；permit 許可；criteria 標準；timeline 時程
  • consultation meeting 諮詢會議；hotline 熱線；follow-up report 後續報告
  • ethics training 倫理訓練；rotation of posts 職務輪調；integrity 廉潔
加分句型
  • without it, even..., ... falls, and ... stalls：三個平行結構強化論點。
  • If..., the public concludes that...：條件句＋推論句，適合分析因素。
  • treat every complaint as a chance to correct a weakness rather than a threat：rather than 對比，展現成熟度。
  • ...are small acts that, repeated a million times, become the credibility of the state.：結尾用分詞構句，收得漂亮。
評分重點
  • 字數：30 分題建議 250–300 字。
  • 結構：四段、每段有 topic sentence。
  • 用字：避免 good / bad，改用具體名詞（credibility, compliance, capture）。
  • 文法：條件句、分詞構句、被動語態運用正確。

title: John was determined to take on a part-time job to make ______ money for his upcoming schooling.
hint:
1. John was determined to take on a part-time job to make extra money for his upcoming schooling.
（約翰決心打工，為即將到來的學業賺取額外的錢。）
  • 考點：extra＝額外的；make extra money 是固定搭配（賺外快）。
  • 線索：part-time job（打工）＋upcoming schooling（即將到來的學業）→ 需要「額外」的錢。
  • 其他選項：harsh 嚴酷的；marital 婚姻的；unique 獨特的——都不能修飾 money。
  • 近義：additional 額外的（較正式）、spare 閒置的。
撇步
  • 「賺（額外的）錢」＝make extra / additional money。

title: Before taking the job, Jim ______ over the possibilities, weighing the good against the bad.
hint:
2. Before taking the job, Jim pondered over the possibilities, weighing the good against the bad.
（接受這份工作前，吉姆仔細思量各種可能性，權衡利弊。）
  • 考點：ponder over＝仔細思考、反覆思量；weighing the good against the bad（權衡利弊）正是思考的內容。
  • 其他選項：merge 合併；reinforce 強化；convey 傳達——都不能接 over 表「思考」。
  • 近義：consider、contemplate、deliberate over。
  • 例句：She pondered over the offer for a week.（她花了一週思量這個提議。）
撇步
  • 「權衡利弊」→ ponder / weigh / deliberate。

title: Edward always makes rash promises about what he is going to do, but he never ______ those promises.
hint:
3. Edward always makes rash promises about what he is going to do, but he never fulfills those promises.
（愛德華總是輕率承諾要做什麼，卻從未兌現那些承諾。）
  • 考點：fulfill a promise＝履行承諾（固定搭配）；rash promises＝輕率的承諾。
  • 句構：but 前後對比：always makes promises ↔ never fulfills them。
  • 其他選項：suspend 暫停；reveal 揭露；coerce 強迫。
  • 例句：He never fulfills his promises.（他從不兌現承諾。）
撇步
  • 承諾的動詞三兄弟：make / keep / fulfill a promise；break a promise 是違背。

title: Some children suffer from malnutrition, mainly because they are ______ dairy products.
hint:
4. Some children suffer from malnutrition, mainly because they are deficient in dairy products.
（有些兒童營養不良，主要是因為他們缺乏乳製品。）
  • 考點：be deficient in＝缺乏……（營養素、某種物質）。
  • 線索：malnutrition（營養不良）→ 原因是「缺乏」某類食物。
  • 其他選項：be aware of 察覺；be informed of 被告知；be reluctant to（不是 in）不願意——介系詞與語意都不合。
  • 例句：Children who are deficient in iron may feel tired.（缺鐵的兒童容易疲倦。）
撇步
  • 缺乏營養＝be deficient in / lack / be short of。

title: It is important to ______ a healthy diet and exercise regularly to keep your body in good shape.
hint:
5. It is important to maintain a healthy diet and exercise regularly to keep your body in good shape.
（重要的是保持健康飲食與規律運動，讓身體維持良好狀態。）
  • 考點：maintain a healthy diet＝維持健康飲食（固定搭配）。
  • 句構：It is important to + V...（形式主語）；to keep your body in good shape 表目的。
  • 其他選項：neglect 忽略；disregard 漠視；relinquish 放棄——都與「維持健康」相反。
  • 例句：She maintains a balanced diet and exercises every day.（她維持均衡飲食，每天運動。）
撇步
  • 「維持」健康／紀律／關係 → maintain。

title: The global economic recession has caused August car sales to ______ the industry's expectations.
hint:
6. The global economic recession has caused August car sales to fall short of the industry's expectations.
（全球經濟衰退使八月汽車銷售未達業界預期。）
  • 考點：fall short of＝未達到（標準、期望）。
  • 線索：recession（衰退）＋expectations（期望）→ 銷售「不如預期」。
  • 其他選項：put up with 忍受；come up with 想出；grow out of 因長大而不再適合。
  • 例句：Profits fell short of expectations.（利潤未達預期。）
撇步
  • 未達標＝fall short of；超越＝exceed / surpass。

title: Awareness of skin cancer has led us to be more ______ of prolonged exposure to sunlight.
hint:
7. Awareness of skin cancer has led us to be more cautious of prolonged exposure to sunlight.
（對皮膚癌的認識讓我們更謹慎面對長時間曝曬於陽光下。）
  • 考點：be cautious of＝對……謹慎、小心。
  • 線索：skin cancer（皮膚癌）＋prolonged exposure（長時間曝曬）→ 要提高警覺。
  • 其他選項：remorseful 懊悔的；deficient 缺乏的；spontaneous 自發的。
  • 例句：Be cautious of slippery floors.（小心地板濕滑。）
撇步
  • 小心／謹慎＝be cautious of / about（也可用 be careful with）。

title: She was ______ for the scholarship because she had a high GPA and participated in many extracurricular activities.
hint:
8. She was eligible for the scholarship because she had a high GPA and participated in many extracurricular activities.
（她符合獎學金資格，因為她 GPA 很高，又參加許多課外活動。）
  • 考點：be eligible for＝符合……的資格。
  • 線索：because 子句列出高 GPA 與課外活動 → 這些是「資格條件」。
  • 其他選項：detain 拘留；procure 取得；negligible 微不足道的。
  • 例句：Only full-time students are eligible for the grant.（只有全職學生符合補助資格。）
撇步
  • 符合資格＝be eligible for / qualify for。

title: The typewriter, replaced by computers and other more advanced devices, is now considered a(n) ______ technology.
hint:
9. The typewriter, replaced by computers and other more advanced devices, is now considered an obsolete technology.
（打字機已被電腦與其他更先進的裝置取代，如今被視為過時的技術。）
  • 考點：obsolete＝過時的、被淘汰的。
  • 線索：replaced by computers（被電腦取代）→ 已是過時技術。
  • 其他選項：conceptual 概念上的；automatic 自動的；convertible 可轉換的。
  • 例句：Fax machines are becoming obsolete.（傳真機正逐漸被淘汰。）
撇步
  • 「被取代、不再使用」→ obsolete（近義：outdated）。

title: Despite the protest of a few workers, we finally managed to reach a ______ about a non-smoking area in the office.
hint:
10. Despite the protest of a few workers, we finally managed to reach a consensus about a non-smoking area in the office.
（儘管少數員工抗議，我們最後還是就辦公室的禁菸區達成共識。）
  • 考點：reach a consensus＝達成共識（固定搭配）。
  • 線索：Despite the protest... finally managed to... → 經過討論後「達成共識」。
  • 其他選項：conservation 保育；consequence 後果；conquest 征服——都不能與 reach 搭配表「共識」。
  • 例句：The committee reached a consensus on the budget.（委員會就預算達成共識。）
撇步
  • 達成共識＝reach / build a consensus。

title: By paying homage to the nation's founding fathers, some politicians were able to ______ a sense of national pride and unity among different parties.
hint:
11. By paying homage to the nation's founding fathers, some politicians were able to instill a sense of national pride and unity among different parties.
（藉由向建國先賢致敬，一些政治人物得以在不同政黨之間灌輸民族自豪感與團結意識。）
  • 考點：instill＝灌輸、逐漸培養（instill A in/into B，或 instill B with A）。
  • 線索：a sense of national pride and unity（自豪感與團結意識）是被「培養」出來的感受。
  • 其他選項：abate 減弱；distain（應為 disdain）輕蔑；nullify 使無效——都不合。
  • 例句：The teacher instilled confidence in her students.（老師培養了學生的自信。）
撇步
  • 培養某種感受／價值 → instill（近義：cultivate、foster）。

title: Although rumor has it that previous elections in the school were ______ by the former principal, there has never been any evidence.
hint:
12. Although rumor has it that previous elections in the school were rigged by the former principal, there has never been any evidence.
（雖然傳聞說校內先前的選舉遭到前校長操縱，卻從來沒有任何證據。）
  • 考點：rig an election＝操縱選舉（固定搭配）。
  • 句構：rumor has it that...＝傳聞說……；were rigged 為被動式。
  • 其他選項：reveal 揭露；reckon 認為；relate 關聯——都不能表達「操縱選舉」。
  • 例句：The vote was widely believed to have been rigged.（一般認為那次投票遭到操縱。）
撇步
  • 選舉被動手腳＝rigged；rumor has it that 是閱讀常客。

title: When we ask the students to choose between red and green apples, they always go for the ______ option; they think green apples taste better.
hint:
13. When we ask the students to choose between red and green apples, they always go for the latter option; they think green apples taste better.
（當我們要學生在紅蘋果與綠蘋果之間選擇時，他們總是選後者；他們覺得綠蘋果比較好吃。）
  • 考點：the latter＝（兩者中的）後者；對應 the former 前者。
  • 線索：between red and green apples（兩者）＋後面說 green apples → 答案是「後者」。
  • 其他選項：late 遲的；later 較晚的（時間）；belated 遲來的——都不是「後者」。
  • 例句：Of the two plans, I prefer the latter.（兩個方案中，我偏好後者。）
撇步
  • 拼字陷阱：latter（後者） vs later（較晚）；前者是 former。

title: The film industry has long noticed that as they ______ to other countries, their films are receiving more attention and a larger fan base.
hint:
14. The film industry has long noticed that as they immigrate to other countries, their films are receiving more attention and a larger fan base.
（電影產業早已注意到，隨著他們移居其他國家，他們的電影獲得更多關注與更大的粉絲群。）
  • 考點：本題官方答案為 (B) immigrate——指電影工作者／產業「移往」其他國家發展。
  • 辨析：immigrate to＝移入（從外地遷入）；emigrate from＝移出；migrate 指動物或人口遷徙。
  • 其他選項：reduce 減少；dissolve 解散；mitigate 緩和——都不合「前往他國」的語意。
  • 例句：Many artists immigrate to the United States to pursue their careers.（許多藝術家移居美國發展事業。）
撇步
  • 記方向：immigrate to（移入）／emigrate from（移出）。

title: Although still being treated with breast cancer, the supermodel appeared on the TV interview ______, looking young and beautiful as always.
hint:
15. Although still being treated with breast cancer, the supermodel appeared on the TV interview glamorously, looking young and beautiful as always.
（儘管仍在接受乳癌治療，這位超模光鮮亮麗地出現在電視訪談中，看起來一如往常年輕美麗。）
  • 考點：glamorously＝光鮮亮麗地、迷人地（glamour 魅力）。
  • 線索：supermodel、looking young and beautiful→ 一定是「亮眼地」出現。
  • 其他選項：dubiously 可疑地；notoriously 惡名昭彰地；reminiscently 懷舊地。
  • 例句：She arrived glamorously dressed in a silver gown.（她穿著銀色禮服、光采動人地抵達。）
撇步
  • 時尚、明星、美麗 → glamorous / glamorously。

title: After the ______ of his legs due to a terrible car accident three years ago, the man now can finally move around on a wheelchair.
hint:
16. After the amputation of his legs due to a terrible car accident three years ago, the man now can finally move around on a wheelchair.
（三年前一場嚴重車禍導致他雙腿截肢，如今他終於能靠輪椅行動。）
  • 考點：amputation＝截肢（amputate 切除）。
  • 線索：legs、car accident、wheelchair → 一定是「截肢」。
  • 其他選項：mummification 木乃伊化；decomposition 分解；reflection 反射、反思。
  • 例句：He lost his leg to amputation after the accident.（那場事故後他因截肢失去一條腿。）
撇步
  • 車禍＋輪椅 → amputation。

title: After hearing my explanation, the customs officer who had been ______ in the first place stamped my passport to let me go without examining my luggage.
hint:
17. After hearing my explanation, the customs officer who had been suspicious in the first place stamped my passport to let me go without examining my luggage.
（聽了我的解釋後，原本心存懷疑的海關人員在我的護照上蓋章，讓我不用檢查行李就通關。）
  • 考點：suspicious＝懷疑的；in the first place＝起初、一開始。
  • 線索：After hearing my explanation... let me go without examining → 原本「懷疑」，聽了解釋才放行。
  • 其他選項：carefree 無憂無慮；sophisticated 老練的；merciful 仁慈的。
  • 例句：The officer was suspicious of the traveler's story.（海關人員對這名旅客的說法起疑。）
撇步
  • 被海關攔下、解釋後放行 → suspicious（懷疑）。

title: If you agree with what he proposed, then we would have a ______ decision and close this meeting much earlier than planned.
hint:
18. If you agree with what he proposed, then we would have a unanimous decision and close this meeting much earlier than planned.
（如果你同意他的提案，我們就能做出一致的決定，並比預定時間早很多結束會議。）
  • 考點：unanimous＝全體一致的；a unanimous decision＝一致的決議。
  • 線索：If you agree...（大家同意）→ 決議是「一致」的，所以能提早散會。
  • 其他選項：conflicting 相互衝突；divided 分歧的；unknown 未知的。
  • 例句：The board reached a unanimous decision.（董事會做出全體一致的決議。）
撇步
  • 全體同意 → unanimous（反義：divided / split）。

title: Many nations decided to ______ economic sanctions on the invading country.
hint:
19. Many nations decided to impose economic sanctions on the invading country.
（許多國家決定對侵略國施加經濟制裁。）
  • 考點：impose A on B＝對 B 施加 A（制裁、關稅、罰則等）。
  • 線索：economic sanctions（經濟制裁）、invading country（侵略國）→ 施加制裁。
  • 其他選項：expose 暴露；recap 摘要；depose 罷黜。
  • 例句：The UN imposed sanctions on the regime.（聯合國對該政權施加制裁。）
撇步
  • impose sanctions / tariffs / a fine on——「施加」都用 impose。

title: After a series of protests, the king was forced with no other option but to ______ his throne.
hint:
20. After a series of protests, the king was forced with no other option but to renounce his throne.
（一連串抗議之後，國王被迫別無選擇，只能放棄王位。）
  • 考點：renounce the throne＝放棄王位（renounce＝正式放棄）。
  • 線索：forced with no other option but to...（被迫別無選擇）→ 只能「放棄」。
  • 其他選項：regard 看待；yield 讓步（yield to）；yodel 唱約德爾調。
  • 例句：The king renounced the throne in favor of his son.（國王放棄王位，讓位給兒子。）
撇步
  • 放棄王位／權利／國籍 → renounce（比 give up 正式）。

title:
Between about 1910 and 1930, new artistic movements in European art were making themselves felt in the United States. American artists became acquainted with the new art on their trips to Paris and at the exhibitions in the famous New York gallery “291” (named after its address on Fifth Avenue) of the photographer Alfred Stieglitz. But most important in the spread of the modern movements in the United States was the sensational Armory Show of 1913 held in New York, in which the works of many of the leading European artists were seen along with the works of a number of progressive American painters.

Several of the American modernists who were influenced by the Armory Show found the urban landscape, especially New York, an appealing subject. Compared with the works of the realist painters, the works of American modernists were much further removed from the actual appearance of the city; they were more interested in the “feel” of the city, and more concerned with the meaning behind the appearance. However, both the painters of the “Ash Can School” and the later realists were still tied to nineteenth-century or earlier styles, while the early modernists shared in the international breakthroughs of the art of the twentieth century.

The greatest of these breakthroughs was Cubism, which developed most fully in France between 1907 and 1914, and brought about a major revolution in Western painting. It overturned the rational tradition that had been built upon since the Renaissance. In Cubism, natural forms were broken down analytically into geometric shapes. No longer was a clear differentiation made between the figure and the background of a painting: the objects represented and the surface on which they were painted became one. The Cubists abandoned the conventional single vantage point of the viewer, and objects depicted from multiple viewpoints were shown at the same time.

subItems.title: 21. What topic is the passage primarily concerned with?

options.text: Modern art movements in the United States.
The influence of photography on landscape painters.

subItems.hint:
→ Modern art movements in the United States.
（這篇文章主要在談什麼？→ 美國的現代藝術運動。）
  • 定位：第一段開頭「Between about 1910 and 1930, new artistic movements in European art were making themselves felt in the United States.」，整段談現代藝術如何傳入美國。
  • 結構：第一段＝傳入途徑；第二段＝美國現代主義者的風格；第三段＝立體主義（作為最重要的突破舉例）。
  • 其他選項：(A) 立體主義只是第三段的例子，不是全文主旨；(B) 文章重點在美國，不是歐洲當代藝術家；(D) 攝影只在第一段提一句（Stieglitz 是攝影師），不是主題。
撇步
  • 主旨題看第一段的主題句：出現 in the United States 就是範圍。

subItems.title: 22. According to the passage, in which year may European art trends affect art forms in the United States?
subItems.hint:
→ 1913
（根據本文，歐洲藝術潮流可能在哪一年影響美國的藝術形式？→ 1913 年。）
  • 定位：第一段「most important in the spread of the modern movements in the United States was the sensational Armory Show of 1913 held in New York...」——1913 年的軍械庫展覽是傳播的關鍵。
  • 其他選項：1936 超出文章年代（1910–1930）；1901、1905 都早於軍械庫展覽，文中未提。
  • 注意：題目問「in which year may...」＝從文中可推得的年份，答案就是 1913。
撇步
  • 年份題直接掃描數字：1910、1930、1913、1907、1914——題目問「影響美國」，對應 1913 的 Armory Show。

subItems.title: 23. Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a means through which American artists learned about new movements?
subItems.hint:
→ Lessons from successful artists.
（下列何者不是文中提到美國藝術家認識新運動的途徑？→ 向成功藝術家學習。）
  • 定位：第一段列出三個途徑：trips to Paris（A）、exhibitions at the gallery “291”（D）、the Armory Show of 1913（B）。
  • (C) 未提及：文中沒有說美國藝術家「拜師學藝」或上課學習。
  • 注意否定題：題目問 NOT mentioned，三個有提、一個沒提，答案就是沒提的那個。
撇步
  • 否定題先把有提到的打勾，剩下的就是答案。

subItems.title: 24. Why does the author mention Alfred Stieglitz?

options.text: To compare him to other artists of the time.
To give an example of someone who had an influence on modern art.
To point out that many artists learned their craft by studying with him.
To demonstrate that photography was the major influence in modern art.

subItems.hint:
→ To give an example of someone who had an influence on modern art.
（作者為什麼提到 Alfred Stieglitz？→ 舉例說明他對現代藝術有影響。）
  • 定位：第一段「...at the exhibitions in the famous New York gallery “291” ... of the photographer Alfred Stieglitz.」——他是 291 藝廊的主持人，該藝廊展出新藝術。
  • 功能：作者用他來說明「美國藝術家透過 291 藝廊接觸新藝術」，也就是他對現代藝術的傳播有影響力。
  • 其他選項：(A) 沒有比較；(C) 文中沒說藝術家向他學藝；(D) 文章沒說攝影是現代藝術的主要影響。
撇步
  • 「為何提及某人」題：找那個人在段落中的功能（舉例、對比、佐證），不是找他個人的成就。

subItems.title: 25. According to the passage, which of the following was a major new movement in twentieth-century art?
subItems.hint:
→ Cubism.
（根據本文，下列何者是二十世紀藝術的重大新運動？→ 立體主義。）
  • 定位：第三段「The greatest of these breakthroughs was Cubism, which developed most fully in France between 1907 and 1914, and brought about a major revolution in Western painting.」
  • 其他選項：(B) 寫實主義——文中說 later realists 仍「tied to nineteenth-century or earlier styles」；(C) 印象派——文中未提；(D) 理性傳統——是被立體主義「推翻」的對象，不是新運動。
撇步
  • 問「二十世紀的新運動」→ 找文中與 twentieth century / breakthrough / revolution 並列的名詞。
